The '''Imperial Ravager Droid''' was a specialized eight-legged model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] deployed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
